candidates.statement: 2.2 Who should report ? Professionals working in healthcare are the preferred source of information in pharmacovigilance. These include family practitioners, medical specialists, nurses and pharmacists and pharmacy technicians.
candidates.context: The reporting forms will be distributed throughout the target area to healthcare professionals at regular intervals. Telephone, fax and electronic mail or internet can be used for reporting ADR’s. Other health workers and family members can play an important role in the stimulation of reporting and in the provision of additional information (e.g. on co-medication and previous drug use).

candidates.statement: 4. Completed forms must be returned to the National Pharmacovigilance Monitoring Centre, Gaborone Send the Form to: No Stamp Required National Pharmacovigilance Centre Drug Regulatory Unit Ministry of Health P/Bag 0038, Gaborone Botswana
